events.brand: Peanuts × Charles M. Schulz Museum and Research Center
events.address: 25 Little West 12th St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A free exhibition exploring Peanuts through fashion, creativity and culture, with archival material, designer-dressed Snoopy and Woodstock pieces, immersive installations and a gift shop.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary admission to the exhibition. Merchandise in the gift shop is for sale.
events.caveats: Hours may vary for special events. The exhibition runs September 2–26 and is normally listed as 10 AM–6 PM daily.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in admission is free. Expect heavier crowds during Fashion Week and special-programming days.

events.event_name: adidas Originals by Simone Rocha Collection Launch
events.brand: adidas Originals × Simone Rocha × Dover Street Market New York
events.address: Dover Street Market New York, 160 Lexington Ave, New York, NY 10016
events.what_it_is: The New York launch of the adidas Originals by Simone Rocha collection at Dover Street Market New York.
events.what_is_free: Free access to shop the collection. A special Justine Kurland poster is available as a gift with purchase in limited quantities.
events.caveats: The poster is a limited-quantity gift with purchase, not a guaranteed freebie for every visitor.
events.practical_notes: The official DSMNY listing gives a specific launch window of 1–5 PM on September 10.

events.address: Park Avenue Christian Church, 1010 Park Ave, New York, NY 10028
events.what_it_is: A two-session NYFW program combining international runway shows, a designer showroom, New York City Opera performances, live art, sustainability programming, DJ sets and networking.
events.what_is_free: No free public admission is advertised; a valid event ticket is required.
events.caveats: Two ticketed sessions are sold separately and capacity is limited.
events.practical_notes: Choose Slot I or Slot II before purchasing; the official ticketing page lists the complete run of show for each session.

events.what_it_is: A four-hour NYFW social gathering for the UNDISCOVERED community at Damballa.
events.what_is_free: The event is presented as an RSVP-based community social; no take-home giveaway is advertised.
events.caveats: RSVP is required according to the organizer post. The public Linktree confirms the event, date and time but does not expose a stable direct RSVP URL in search results.
events.practical_notes: Open the Damballa Linktree and use the UNDISCOVERED NYFW Link Up item to reach the current RSVP path.

events.event_name: FML Issue III Launch Party — NYFW Edition
events.address: Maison Nur, 217 Bowery, New York, NY 10002
events.what_it_is: FML Magazine's Issue III launch party during NYFW, tied to The Reinvention Issue and featuring the issue's fashion, music and lifestyle cover talent.
events.what_is_free: No ticket price is advertised in the verified event listing; no guaranteed giveaway is advertised.
events.caveats: The flyer says RSVP. A stable public direct RSVP URL was not found. One event listing displays an end time of 1:30 AM while the flyer says 1 AM, so the narrower 9 PM–1 AM flyer window is used.
events.practical_notes: Treat RSVP as required and confirm through FML/Maison Nur before going.

events.address: Foreigner, 31 Bond St, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW takeover of Foreigner in NoHo with custom drinks, DJs and a photo booth.
events.what_is_free: The event is open to the public and advertises a free photo booth. Custom drinks are part of the activation, but a free drink for every attendee is not explicitly guaranteed in the verified listing.
events.caveats: Open to the public. The verified listings do not state a reservation requirement or guarantee a take-home giveaway.
events.practical_notes: The activation runs 9 AM–4 PM at 31 Bond Street.

events.address: Multiple downtown Manhattan locations; exact individual stops not published in the verified listing
events.what_it_is: A multi-neighborhood Fashion Week activation with short fashion shows, fragrance sampling, staged paparazzi and red-carpet-style photo moments.
events.what_is_free: The public activation advertises fragrance sampling and photo opportunities. Exact sample quantities and individual stop inventory are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: The verified public listing confirms SoHo, West Chelsea and Flatiron but does not publish exact street addresses for each activation stop. No map pin should be inferred from the neighborhood names alone.
events.practical_notes: Treat this as a roaming/multi-stop activation unless Fragrance.com publishes exact stop locations closer to the event.

events.brand: Brooklyn Borough President Antonio Reynoso × Colm Dillane / KidSuper
events.address: Brooklyn Borough Hall Plaza, 209 Joralemon St, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: A public outdoor NYFW runway show showcasing five emerging Brooklyn designers, presented by Brooklyn Borough President Antonio Reynoso and Brooklyn Arts Ambassador Colm Dillane of KidSuper.
events.what_is_free: Free public admission on a first-come, first-served basis. Registration is available, but it does not guarantee entry.
events.caveats: First come, first served and standing room only. RSVPing does not guarantee entry. ADA accommodations are available. The official event page lists the program as 6–9:30 PM while the registration form says doors open at 5 PM and showtime is 6 PM.
events.practical_notes: Register in advance, but arrive before showtime because admission remains first-come. Doors open at 5 PM; show begins at 6 PM.
